items.stem: A form asks you to upload 'C:\Users\Mia\Desktop\id.pdf' but you saved it in Downloads. What changed?
choices: The folder part of the path

items.stem: Why do support staff ask 'where are you standing?' when a relative path fails?
choices: Relative paths start from the current folder

items.stem: A 2 TB external drive shows about 1.82 TB on a laptop. What explains it?
A photo folder is 9.5 GB and the free space shows 9 GiB. Fits?
Which password policy best follows current NIST guidance?
choices: Must include a symbol and a capital only
Long passphrases, checked against breached lists, changed on compromise

items.stem: Why can a short password with symbols be weaker than a long lowercase one?
choices: Length adds more bits than symbols when chosen at random

items.stem: A website offers 'remember me' on a shared library computer. Best choice?
choices: Decline and sign out when finished
Accept and leave the tab open
Write the password on the desk

items.stem: An email from 'support@harborbank.example.alerts-help.example.org' asks for your PIN. Who sent it?
A message pressures you to act within ten minutes. What does urgency usually signal?
choices: A tactic to stop you checking

items.stem: You must share a 60 MB video with a teacher. Most reliable method?
choices: Upload and share a view-only link

items.stem: A sheet's total is typed as 1,000 while the rows add to 1,100. What should you fix?
choices: Replace the typed total with =SUM over the rows

items.stem: Which formula finds the average of B2 through B9?
Your accuracy is 90% at 60 WPM. What should practice focus on?
Which posture reduces strain while typing?
choices: Keyboard on your lap at an angle
Square to the keyboard with level wrists

items.stem: A backup drive sits beside the laptop in the same bag. Which threat defeats both?
choices: A power cut at the library

items.stem: You last tested a restore two years ago. What is the plan's status?
Why does a cloud sync folder alone fail 3-2-1?
choices: Deletions and damage sync to every copy

items.stem: A flyer uses white text on pale yellow. What should you do before printing?
Large text needs at least what contrast for WCAG AA?
Which is a real accessibility improvement besides contrast?
choices: Readable font size and clear link text

items.stem: A volunteer asks you to email them your password 'to help'. What do you do?
choices: Refuse and show the request to the desk

items.stem: Where should multi-factor sign-in be turned on first?
Which item belongs in a personal safety plan?
choices: Who to ask when a message looks strange

items.stem: What does the Library Lab course claim when you finish?
choices: Practice-based digital confidence, not a certification
